body:
Angel at your shoulder! ✨
Decorate your base with 1 plushie directly from the world of Blizzard's hit game, Overwatch.
A 1.21.7 Resource Pack is also included for Vanilla.
Tested in game with 1.21.7

Created by EyelessTenshi

## Installation
1. Take the Mercy Plushie 1.21.7 folder and drop it inside your "Resourcepacks" folder.
2. Using Creative Mode ( OP if need be ), run /give @p Minecraft:orange_dye[custom_model_data={floats:[1]}] to give yourself the Plushie.


   

The plushie can be worn on your hat, or placed on an item frame to decorate your home. All code and artwork in this product are the exclusive property of Silent Princess Studios. Unauthorized reproduction, distribution, or resale of this content is strictly prohibited.
